description: Ken Lundy recorded this interview at UCF’s John C. Hitt Library for the Knights Tales Project on September 11, 2026, the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. At the time of the attacks, Lundy worked for Steelcase, whose headquarters was in Grand Rapids, Michigan, and his territory was New York City. He and his wife had recently traveled to the New York City area to find work and a place to stay, then returned to Grand Rapids before September 11. Lundy says he watched events unfold at Steelcase headquarters and could not reach his wife, who was working for Social Security; they met at home later that afternoon. He first visited the World Trade Center towers on Labor Day 2001, met a friend in the shopping area, and recalls seeing people who worked in the building. Lundy remembers the victims and expresses hope and prayer for healing. The interview is part of the UCF Remembers 9/11 collection.
